instruction.text: Maya went food shopping and bought 450 g of apples. When she got home, she realised she already had 250 g of apples in the fruit bowl. How many grams of apples does she have in total?
instruction.sound: Maya went food shopping and bought 450 grams of apples. When she got home, she realised she already had 250 grams of apples in the fruit bowl. How many grams of apples does she have in total?

end.text: Maya has a total of 700 g of apples.

instruction.text: Joe’s dad gained 9 kg during the winter. Last summer, he weighed 79 kg. How much does he weigh now?
instruction.sound: Joe’s dad gained 9 kilograms during the winter. Last summer, he weighed 79 kilograms. How much does he weigh now?

instruction.text: Alice is lifting weights at the gym. She starts lifting with 10 kg. Then she adds 5 kg of weight on the left side and 5 kg of weight on the right side. How many kilograms is she lifting now?
instruction.sound: Alicia is lifting weights at the gym. She starts lifting with 10 kilograms. Then she adds 5 kilograms of weight on the left side and 5 kilograms of weight on the right side. How many kilograms is she lifting now?

instruction.text: Lewis is packing his school bag. His notebook weighs 110 g, his pencil case weighs 200 g and his school book weighs 650 g. How much do they weigh altogether?
instruction.sound: Lewis is packing his school bag. His notebook weighs 110 grams, his pencil case weighs 200 grams and his school book weighs 650 grams. How much do they weigh altogether?

end.text: Lewis’ notebook, school book and pencil case weigh 960 g together.
